finding.text: Under the owner-supplied lifetimes (buffer_A: 0-10s, buffer_B: 0-10s, workspace: 9-20s), the peak memory demand is 17 MiB (buffer_A + buffer_B + workspace active from 9s to 10s). This exceeds the 16 MiB capacity limit. Therefore, the allocations do not fit within the memory limit under the owner's declared schedule. The concurrent assumption (O1) also failed (17 MiB > 16 MiB), confirming that no subset of these specific allocations can simultaneously fit if all are considered concurrent, and the specific owner schedule also fails.
